code='''def transform(grid):
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
    counts = {}
    for color in (2, 4):
        a = sum(row.count(color) for row in top)
        b = sum(row.count(color) for row in bottom)
